components.note: 钅 (metal, simplified 金) — metal radical; a button or knob, as in 钱 money, 铁 iron.
丑 (chǒu) is a loose sound clue; 扭 niǔ and 纽 niǔ share it and sound exactly like 钮.
疒 (illness) — marks diseases and cravings, as in 病 sick, 痛 pain.
隐 (yǐn) gives the exact sound; it also means hidden, like a hidden craving.
尹 (to govern, a hand holding a staff) — the ruler; also in 伊 and 群 qún.
口 (mouth) — the ruler issues commands; 君 also sounds out 群 qún and 裙 qún.
扌 (hand) — giving by hand; also in 给 give, 拿 take.
肙 (yuān) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 娟 juān and 鹃 juān.
贝 (shell, old money) — gifts and valuables, as in 财 wealth, 买 buy, 费 fee.
曾 (zēng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 增 zēng and 憎 zēng.
亻 (person) — a person's precedent or example; also in 他 he, 做 do.
列 (liè) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 烈 liè and 裂 liè.
冬 — the last season of the year; in old script it is related to 终 zhōng "end", as winter ends the year.
纟 (silk, simplified 糸) — plain unmixed thread, hence pure; also in 红 red, 级 level.
屯 (tún) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 钝 dùn and 顿 dùn.
米 (rice, grain) — pure unmixed grain, hence essence; also in 粉 powder, 粮 grain.
卒 (zú) is a loose clue; it starts the cuì series 翠 cuì, 悴 cuì and 瘁 cuì.
光 (light) — shining light; 耀 is to shine or dazzle.
翟 (dí) is a loose sound clue; it also sounds out 曜 yào and 濯 zhuó.
车 (vehicle) — wheeled transport, as in 轮 wheel, 辆 measure word for cars.
乔 (qiáo) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 桥 qiáo, 骄 jiāo and 娇 jiāo.
讠 (speech, simplified 言) — careful words; also in 说 say, 话 speech.
堇 (jǐn) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 勤 qín.
忄 (heart, 竖心旁) — feelings and attitudes, as in 快 happy, 慢 slow; a careful heart.
真 (zhēn) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 镇 zhèn and 填 tián.
王 (jade, 斜玉旁) — gems and jade, as in 球 ball, 玩 play, 珠 pearl; 琳 is a beautiful gem.
林 (lín) gives the exact sound.
土 (earth) — clay and ground; 塑 is to model in clay, as in 地 ground, 城 city.
朔 (shuò) is a loose clue; 溯 sù (to trace back) shares it and sounds the same as 塑.
予 (yǔ) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 预 yù, as in 预备 to prepare.
忄 (heart) — a steady heart, hence constant; also in 快 happy, 慢 slow.
亘 (gèn) is only a loose sound clue for héng.
车 (vehicle) — carrying loads by cart; also in 轮 wheel, 辆 for cars.
哉 (zāi) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 栽 zāi and 裁 cái. Note 载 reads zài in 下载.
月 — a crescent moon, also the word for month; in body words ⺼ is a different part, as in 脸 face.
犭 (animal, 反犬旁) — marks beasts, as in 猫 cat, 狗 dog, 猪 pig.
师 (shī) gives the exact sound, as in 老师 teacher.
氵 (water) — the tide; also in 海 sea, 河 river.
朝 (cháo) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 嘲 cháo.
火 (fire) — flames; also in 灯 lamp, 烧 burn.
臽 (xiàn) is a loose clue; 陷 xiàn and 馅 xiàn share it.
生 (to grow) — old forms of 青 show fresh growing plants plus pigment; the colour is fresh blue-green. 青 also sounds out 清, 请, 情, 晴.
贝 (shell, old money) — wealth and payment, as in 财 wealth, 买 buy.
有 (to have) — owning wealth; 贿 is wealth given to buy favour.
贝 (shell, old money) — gifts of wealth, as in 财 wealth, 买 buy.
各 (gè) is a loose clue; 路 lù and 露 lù share it and sound exactly like 赂.
亻 (person) — an older kinsman; also in 他 he, 们 plural.
白 (bái) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 泊 bó and 柏 bǎi.
罒 (net, 四字头) — as in 罪 crime, 罗 net; 署 originally an office with a net of officials.
者 (zhě) gives a close sound; 暑 shǔ shares it and sounds exactly like 署.
穴 (cave, hole) — blocked openings; also in 空 empty, 窗 window, 突 sudden.
至 (zhì) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 致 zhì and 室 shì.
亻 (person) — a stiff body; also in 你 you, 体 body.
畺 (jiāng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 疆 jiāng and 缰 jiāng.
亻 (person) — one who relies on arms; also in 他 he, 们 plural.
丈 (zhàng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 杖 zhàng.
缶 (earthenware jar) — pottery vessels, as in 罐 jar, 缺 lack; 缸 is a crock or vat.
工 (gōng) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 红 hóng and 江 jiāng.
辶 (walk, 走之旁) — movement and roads, as in 道 road, 过 pass, 进 enter.
土 (earth) — a mound of earth; also in 地 ground, 城 city.
文 (wén) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 蚊 wén and 纹 wén.
土 (earth) — a burial in the ground; also in 地 ground, 城 city.
莫 (mò) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 幕 mù, 慕 mù and 募 mù.
木 (wood) — palm trees; also in 树 tree, 林 forest.
宗 (zōng) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 踪 zōng and 综 zōng.
舟 (boat) — ships, as in 船 ship, 航 sail.
见 (jiàn) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 览 lǎn and 现 xiàn loosely.
贝 (shell, old money) — value and price, as in 财 wealth, 买 buy, 费 fee.
攵 (tap, strike; 攴) — an action, here to open up; also in 收 gather, 教 teach.
尚 (shàng) gives a loose sound; it also sounds out 常 cháng and 掌 zhǎng.
糸 (silk, simplified 纟) — undyed silk: plain and basic, hence 元素 element and 素食 vegetarian fare.
阝 (city, 右耳旁 on the right) — marks places, as in 都 capital, 邮 mail; the gloomy sense of 郁 is a borrowed one.
有 (yǒu) hints at the sound only loosely.
心 (heart) — a gloomy feeling; also in 想 think, 急 anxious.
门 (mén) gives a close sound; 们 men shares it. 闷 reads mēn (stuffy) or mèn (gloomy).
阝 (mound, 左耳旁 on the left) — hills and heights, as in 院 courtyard, 阳 sunny side, 队 team.
扌 (hand) — blocking with the hand; also in 推 push, 打 hit.
当 (dāng) gives the sound, with a different tone; 档 dàng shares it.
纟 (silk, simplified 糸) — taking in thread; also in 红 red, 级 level.
内 (nèi) gives a close sound; it also sounds out 钠 nà (sodium).
尸 (body) — a body being butchered; also in 层 layer, 屋 room.
者 (zhě) is only a loose sound clue; 堵 dǔ and 赌 dǔ also use it.
虫 (insect, creature) — marks small creatures, as in 蛇 snake, 蚊 mosquito; in 蛮 it is part of an old, derogatory label for outsiders.
艹 (grass) — plants; also in 花 flower, 草 grass.
重 (zhòng) is only a loose clue; 懂 dǒng (to understand) shares 董 and sounds the same.
身 (body) — the body ducking away; also in 躺 lie down, 躬.
朵 (duǒ) gives the exact sound; it also sounds out 垛 duò.
